sections.title: What can Meldmind do
sections.body:
Meldmind is one window for the AIs you already pay for. You say what you want. It can ask one AI, a council, or a mission. You watch the work and you see the cost.

You can hand a job to another AI, such as a chat you already have open or Grok Bot. That AI can tell Meldmind when it is finished. You get a notice, and the summary shows in the job. If it cannot call back, use Paste result. Nothing from that paste is saved until you click Save.

sections.title: Get it done
sections.body:
Get it done lets one job run its steps without asking. Turn it on for that job, or say get it done, don't ask me. It ends when the job ends. Spending money and a permanent delete still need one tap. Sending a message stays off unless you turn that on. Stop and the activity log stay on.

Always for this kind of job is in Settings, and you can revoke it any time. The handoff prompt tells the other AI the permission level. Spending money and a permanent delete still need one tap.

sections.title: Passwords
sections.body:
When a job, a step in the browser helper, or a connection asks you to sign in, a small tip appears. You can dismiss it.

Tip: keep your passwords in a password manager like 1Password (or Bitwarden, free). Meldmind never stores your passwords.

1Password: https://1password.com
Bitwarden: https://bitwarden.com

sections.title: When another AI finishes
sections.body:
You can hand a job to another AI (Continue in, or Send to Grok Bot). The prompt asks that AI to tell Meldmind when it is finished.

You get a notice, and the summary shows in the job. If that AI cannot call back, use Paste result and paste what it wrote. A line that starts with DONE: is enough. It is saved only when you click Save.

With no hosted hub on this computer, Paste result is the way back. A report back reaches only the person who handed off the job. The hub deletes it when your app picks it up, or after 7 days, and it keeps no list of those summaries.
